tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.title: AIAgentCycle company profile
tools.description:
Who AIAgentCycle is: summary, legal name, location, founder, focus and approach. lang is nl or en.
facts_verified tells whether the key facts still appear on the About page.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Contact AIAgentCycle
tools.description:
Public contact route: email, phone/WhatsApp, contact page and the free assessment (scan) page.
This server cannot send messages or book appointments.

tools.name: get_document
tools.title: Read one AIAgentCycle page in full
tools.description:
Full text (Markdown) of one page, article, case, solution, sector or integration page, with its
source url, language and last-modified date. Ids come from search_knowledge_base or list_documents.

id.description: Numeric document id from search_knowledge_base or list_documents, for example 20 for the Dutch pricing page.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.title: AIAgentCycle FAQ
tools.description:
Frequently asked questions about prices, maintenance and approach, verbatim from the pricing page.
lang is nl or en.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: One AIAgentCycle service
tools.description: One public service by id (ids come from list_services). An unknown id is an error.

service_id.description: Service id exactly as returned by list_services, for example quick-win, techbeheer or serverbeheer.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.title: AIAgentCycle case studies
tools.description:
Published case studies (client and own projects) with title, summary and url. Read one in full with
get_document. lang is nl or en.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List AIAgentCycle pages
tools.description:
Catalogue of the website: id, type, title, url, last-modified date and a one-line summary per
document. lang is nl or en. type optionally narrows to: article, page, integration, case, solution, sector.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

type.description: Optional filter on document type: article, page, integration, case, solution or sector. Leave empty for all types.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.title: Systems AIAgentCycle integrates
tools.description:
The integrations catalogue of aiagentcycle.com (190 systems): name, status, domain, category,
description, open-source license and a detail-page url where one exists. Status: productie = already
running in production at AIAgentCycle or a client; standaard = n8n has a built-in node; maatwerk = custom
via API, export, database or screen automation. Filters: query (name or text, max 100 chars), domain
(administratie, verkoop, samenwerken, data), status, open_source. lang is nl or en. A system that is not
listed can usually still be connected through one of those four routes.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

query.description: Optional words that must all occur in the name, description, category or license, for example 'twinfield' or 'crm'. Max 100 characters.

domain.description: Optional domain filter: administratie (finance and admin), verkoop (customers and sales), samenwerken (work and communication) or data (data, servers and AI).

status.description: Optional status filter: productie (running in production), standaard (n8n built-in node) or maatwerk (custom).

open_source.description: true for only open-source systems, false for only proprietary ones; leave out for both.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: AIAgentCycle services and prices
tools.description:
All public services and maintenance packages with indicative prices (excl. VAT, business clients).
Each price carries price_verified: true if it still appears verbatim on the live pricing page.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.title: Search the AIAgentCycle website
tools.description:
Ranked full-text search over every page, solution, sector page, case, integration and article of
aiagentcycle.com. Any word may match; documents matching more words rank higher. lang is nl or en.
type optionally narrows to: article, page, integration, case, solution, sector. query max 100 chars,
limit 1-10. Each hit has an id for get_document and the source url.

query.description: Search words, 1 to 100 characters, in the language of lang, for example 'Exact Online koppeling' or 'AI agent cost'.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return, 1 to 10.

type.description: Optional filter on document type: article, page, integration, case, solution or sector. Leave empty for all types.
